Writing that lives in Google Docs rather than on this site. Each document is
edited in Google Docs and nothing is copied here. Sharing is set per document,
so a link may ask for permission.

## Book Notes

- [Designing Your Life](../books/designing-your-life.qmd). Burnett and Evans on
  treating a career as a design problem rather than a search for one right
  answer.
- [The Problem of the Puer Aeternus](../books/puer-aeternus.qmd). Von Franz on
  the adult who keeps life provisional, and on work as the way out.
- [Finding Meaning in the Second Half of Life](../books/second-half-of-life.qmd).
  The second half as its own task rather than a decline from the first.

## Other Notes
